```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Compute landing-page stats dynamically at render time.
# Each remote query is wrapped in tryCatch; fallback is "—" so render
# succeeds even when HuggingFace is offline.

local({
  # Path-checked pkgload (cwd-trap fix: here::here() returns docs/ under quarto render) — #387
  pkg_path <- if (dir.exists("packages/historicaldata")) "packages/historicaldata" else
    file.path(dirname(here::here()), "packages/historicaldata")
  suppressMessages(pkgload::load_all(pkg_path, quiet = TRUE))

  n_tickers <- tryCatch({
    tickers_equity <- hd_tickers("equity_daily")
    tickers_crypto <- hd_tickers("crypto_daily")
    length(unique(c(tickers_equity, tickers_crypto)))
  }, error = function(e) NA_integer_)

  n_datasets <- tryCatch(length(hd_datasets()), error = function(e) NA_integer_)

  n_rows <- tryCatch({
    ds_names <- names(hd_datasets())
    row_counts <- sapply(ds_names, function(nm) {
      tryCatch({
        ds <- hd_datasets()[[nm]]
        duckplyr::read_parquet_duckdb(ds$url) |>
          dplyr::count() |>
          dplyr::collect() |>
          dplyr::pull(n)
      }, error = function(e) 0L)
    })
    sum(row_counts)
  }, error = function(e) NA_integer_)

  yr_history <- tryCatch({
    # Collect per-dataset min/max as character first (avoids POSIXct/numeric
    # conversion hazard when unlist() strips Date class → epoch seconds).
    date_datasets <- c("equity_daily", "crypto_daily", "macro_daily", "factors")
    date_pairs <- lapply(date_datasets, function(nm) {
      tryCatch({
        ds <- hd_datasets()[[nm]]
        row <- duckplyr::read_parquet_duckdb(ds$url) |>
          dplyr::summarise(
            min_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_date = max(date, na.rm = TRUE)
          ) |>
          dplyr::collect()
        # Coerce each value to Date via character to avoid epoch-seconds hazard
        list(
          min = as.Date(as.character(row$min_date[[1]])),
          max = as.Date(as.character(row$max_date[[1]]))
        )
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    })
    date_pairs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), date_pairs)
    if (length(date_pairs) == 0L) return(NA_integer_)
    all_min <- as.Date(sapply(date_pairs, function(p) as.character(p$min)),
                       origin = "1970-01-01")
    all_max <- as.Date(sapply(date_pairs, function(p) as.character(p$max)),
                       origin = "1970-01-01")
    overall_min <- min(all_min, na.rm = TRUE)
    overall_max <- max(all_max, na.rm = TRUE)
    as.integer(round(as.numeric(difftime(overall_max, overall_min,
                                         units = "days")) / 365.25))
  }, error = function(e) NA_integer_)

  # Count exported functions from pkgctx-generated API doc (dynamic-prose-values rule).
  # Pattern "^kind: function" matches one line per exported function.
  # Source: docs/api-historicaldata.md (generated by scripts/regen_api_context.sh).
  n_functions <- tryCatch({
    api_path <- if (file.exists("api-historicaldata.md")) "api-historicaldata.md" else
      file.path(here::here(), "api-historicaldata.md")
    lines <- readLines(api_path, warn = FALSE)
    sum(grepl("^kind: function", lines))
  }, error = function(e) NA_integer_)

  # Dataset registry table (rendered in the Datasets page): one row per entry of
  # hd_datasets(); coverage (distinct tickers / series / factors and first year)
  # is read from the parquet files. "—" means the query failed, not zero.
  ds_all <- tryCatch(hd_datasets(), error = function(e) NULL)
  dataset_rows <- NULL
  if (!is.null(ds_all)) {
    dataset_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ds_all), function(nm) {
      ds <- ds_all[[nm]]
      key <- intersect(c("ticker", "series_id", "factor_name"), ds$schema)[1]
      coverage <- tryCatch({
        if (is.na(ds$url) || is.na(key) || !"date" %in% ds$schema ||
            !grepl("hf://", ds$url, fixed = TRUE)) stop("no coverage query")
        r <- duckplyr::read_parquet_duckdb(ds$url) |>
          dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n_distinct(!!rlang::sym(key)),
                           first = min(date, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
          dplyr::collect()
        unit <- c(ticker = "tickers", series_id = "series", factor_name = "factors")[[key]]
        paste0(format(r$n[[1]], big.mark = ","), " ", unit, ", from ",
               substr(as.character(r$first[[1]]), 1L, 4L))
      }, error = function(e) "\u2014")
      what <- sub("\\. .*$", "", ds$description)
      if (isTRUE(ds$survivorship_biased)) what <- paste0(what, " (survivorship-biased)")
      data.frame(dataset = nm, frequency = ds$frequency, coverage = coverage,
                 what = what, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  }
  assign("dataset_rows", dataset_rows, envir = parent.env(environment()))

  # Format helpers
  fmt_tickers   <- if (is.na(n_tickers))   "—" else format(n_tickers, big.mark = ",")
  fmt_rows      <- if (is.na(n_rows))      "—" else paste0(round(n_rows / 1e6, 1), "M")
  fmt_datasets  <- if (is.na(n_datasets))  "—" else as.character(n_datasets)
  fmt_yr        <- if (is.na(yr_history))  "—" else paste0(yr_history, "yr")
  fmt_functions <- if (is.na(n_functions)) "—" else as.character(n_functions)

  # Export to parent env so inline R blocks can reference them
  assign("stat_tickers",   fmt_tickers,   envir = parent.env(environment()))
  assign("stat_rows",      fmt_rows,      envir = parent.env(environment()))
  assign("stat_datasets",  fmt_datasets,  envir = parent.env(environment()))
  assign("stat_yr",        fmt_yr,        envir = parent.env(environment()))
  assign("stat_functions", fmt_functions, envir = parent.env(environment()))
})
```

```{r}
#| label: verdict-setup
#| include: false
# The verdict table reads the one home of strategy status (the strategy_verdict
# target, rule in R/strategy_verdict.R), the same way leaderboard.qmd and
# failures.qmd read their targets: path-checked store, cwd is docs/ under
# quarto render and the project root under tar_make.
library(targets)
store_path <- if (dir.exists("_targets")) "_targets" else
  file.path(here::here(), "docs/_targets")
tar_config_set(store = store_path)

utils_path <- if (file.exists("vignette_utils.R")) "vignette_utils.R" else
  file.path(here::here(), "docs/vignette_utils.R")
source(utils_path)

sv_path <- if (file.exists("../R/strategy_verdict.R")) "../R/strategy_verdict.R" else
  file.path(here::here(), "R/strategy_verdict.R")
source(sv_path)

strategy_verdict_tbl <- safe_tar_read("strategy_verdict")

# Emit hand-built HTML as a raw block so pandoc does not re-parse our <table>
# into a native Table (Quarto's dashboard filter cannot traverse its body).
raw_html <- function(...) {
  cat("```{=html}\n", paste(c(...), collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
}
```

# Overview

## Row

Every strategy on this site goes through the same pipeline. Each stage links to its page.

```{r}
#| label: pipeline-diagram
#| output: asis
stages <- list(
  list("Data", "index.html#datasets", "Prices, macro and factor series from public sources."),
  list("Strategies", "stock-backtest.html", "Each idea is backtested on that data."),
  list("Costs", "leaderboard.html", "Returns are taken net of trading costs and turnover."),
  list("Testing", "falsification.html", "Is it alpha, or luck and factor exposure?"),
  list("Verdict", "leaderboard.html", "One rule sorts each strategy into Keep, Watch or Failed."),
  list("Failures", "failures.html", "Why each Failed or Watch strategy is not Keep.")
)
items <- vapply(seq_along(stages), function(i) {
  s <- stages[[i]]
  sprintf('<li><a href="%s"><span class="stage">%d. %s</span><span class="what">%s</span></a></li>',
          s[[2]], i, s[[1]], s[[3]])
}, character(1))
raw_html("<ol class=\"pipeline\">", items, "</ol>")
```

## Row

```{r}
#| label: verdict-table
sv <- strategy_verdict_tbl
if (is.null(sv) || nrow(sv) == 0L) {
  cat("*`strategy_verdict` target not available. Run `tar_make()`.*\n")
} else {
  esc <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", htmltools::htmlEscape(x))
  # Keep first, then Watch, then Failed (the order of STRATEGY_VERDICT_LEVELS).
  sv <- sv[order(match(sv$verdict, STRATEGY_VERDICT_LEVELS), sv$short_name), ]
  tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    Strategy = esc(sv$short_name),
    Verdict = sprintf('<span class="vd vd-%s">%s</span>', tolower(sv$verdict), esc(sv$verdict)),
    Why = esc(sv$verdict_reason)
  )
  DT::datatable(
    tbl,
    caption = hd_caption(strategy_verdict_counts_text(sv$verdict)),
    escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE, ordering = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
  )
}
```

# Datasets

## Row

Historical finance database for backtesting: equities, crypto, macro, and factors. Code-only R package — data hosted on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/JohnGavin/finance-data){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}, queried via DuckDB `hf://` protocol with predicate pushdown.

<h4>Factor MAX and <abbr title="Dynamic Rotation Into Factors — selects best-performing FF factor each month">DRIF</abbr></h4>

The test was corrected for look-ahead (#868), so its results are not a replication of Varma's BTC figures. Not a strategy.</p>

## Row

Built with the [T language](https://github.com/b-rodrigues/tlang){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"} pipeline, [targets](https://docs.ropensci.org/targets/){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}, [DuckDB](https://duckdb.org/){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}, and [Quarto](https://quarto.org/){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}. Data from Yahoo Finance, FRED, and Ken French Data Library. Source, issues and CI: [GitHub](https://github.com/JohnGavin/historical).

# Installation

## Row

### {.tabset}

#### R (pak)

```r
# Install from GitHub
pak::pak("JohnGavin/historical", subdir = "packages/historicaldata")

# Then:
library(historicaldata)
hd_ohlcv("AAPL", from = "2024-01-01")
hd_ohlcv(hd_group("FAANG"), from = "2024-01-01")  # batch query
hd_macro(c("SP500", "VIXCLS"), from = "2024-01-01")
hd_search("vanguard")  # search metadata
```

```{r}
#| label: install-check
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Re-runs the four example commands above on every page render, so the
# output stays in sync with the live HuggingFace data and the package
# code on this commit.
show_query <- function(label, expr) {
  cat("# > ", label, "\n", sep = "")
  result <- tryCatch(eval(expr, envir = parent.frame()),
                     error = function(e) {
                       cat("# ERROR: ", conditionMessage(e), "\n", sep = "")
                       NULL
                     })
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    # Materialise lazy duckplyr queries before head/print
    if (inherits(result, c("duckplyr_df", "tbl_lazy"))) {
      result <- dplyr::collect(result)
    }
    print(utils::head(result, 5L))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

show_query('hd_ohlcv("AAPL", from = "2024-01-01")',
           quote(hd_ohlcv("AAPL", from = "2024-01-01")))
show_query('hd_ohlcv(hd_group("FAANG"), from = "2024-01-01")  # batch query',
           quote(hd_ohlcv(hd_group("FAANG"), from = "2024-01-01")))
show_query('hd_macro(c("SP500", "VIXCLS"), from = "2024-01-01")',
           quote(hd_macro(c("SP500", "VIXCLS"), from = "2024-01-01")))
show_query('hd_search("vanguard")  # search metadata',
           quote(hd_search("vanguard")))
```

#### Python (DuckDB)

No R needed — query the same data directly from Python using DuckDB's native `hf://` protocol:

```python
import duckdb

con = duckdb.connect()
df = con.sql("""
    SELECT date, close, volume
    FROM 'hf://datasets/JohnGavin/finance-data/equity_daily.parquet'
    WHERE ticker = 'AAPL' AND date >= '2024-01-01'
    ORDER BY date
""").df()
```

#### Nix

```bash
# Enter reproducible Nix shell (all R + Python packages included)
nix develop github:JohnGavin/historical
```

Then start R and load the package. All dependencies (dplyr, ggplot2, scales, DT, arrow, duckdb) are pre-installed in the Nix shell.

```{r}
#| label: nix-verify
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Show flake metadata for the active project — proves the nix-develop
# target above resolves to a concrete commit + dependency tree.
flake_dir <- if (file.exists(file.path(here::here(), "flake.nix"))) {
               here::here()
             } else {
               dirname(here::here())
             }
md <- tryCatch(
  system2("nix", c("flake", "metadata", flake_dir, "--json"),
          stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
if (length(md) > 0L && requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  j <- jsonlite::fromJSON(paste(md, collapse = ""))
  cat("# > nix flake metadata\n", sep = "")
  cat("description:    ", j$description %||% "(none)", "\n", sep = "")
  cat("last_modified:  ",
      if (!is.null(j$lastModified))
        format(as.POSIXct(j$lastModified, origin = "1970-01-01"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")
      else "(unknown)", "\n", sep = "")
  cat("locked_rev:     ", substr(j$locked$rev %||% "", 1L, 12L), "\n", sep = "")
  inputs <- names(j$locks$nodes)
  inputs <- setdiff(inputs, "root")
  cat("inputs (", length(inputs), "):  ",
      paste(inputs, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("# > nix flake metadata\n# (nix not on PATH at render time; trust the locked flake)\n", sep = "")
}
```

#### T language

```bash
# Clone, enter Nix shell, fetch data, run pipeline
git clone https://github.com/JohnGavin/historical.git && cd historical
nix develop
python scripts/fetch_equity.py     # equity tickers
Rscript scripts/fetch_crypto.R     # crypto tokens
Rscript scripts/fetch_macro.R      # FRED macro series
Rscript scripts/fetch_factors.R    # Fama-French factors
t run src/pipeline.t               # T pipeline
```

```{r}
#| label: pipeline-overview
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# The full clone + fetch + pipeline run takes ~20 min; not feasible at
# page-render time. Instead, show the static shape: how many fetch
# scripts exist, how many pipeline targets, file sizes.
root <- if (file.exists(file.path(here::here(), "scripts"))) {
          here::here()
        } else {
          dirname(here::here())
        }

fetch_scripts <- list.files(file.path(root, "scripts"),
                            pattern = "^fetch_.*\\.(R|py)$",
                            full.names = FALSE)
n_r  <- sum(grepl("\\.R$",  fetch_scripts))
n_py <- sum(grepl("\\.py$", fetch_scripts))

pipeline_file <- file.path(root, "src", "pipeline.t")
pipeline_lines <- if (file.exists(pipeline_file)) {
                    length(readLines(pipeline_file, warn = FALSE))
                  } else {
                    NA_integer_
                  }

n_targets <- tryCatch({
  if (file.exists(file.path(root, "docs", "_targets.R"))) {
    manifest <- targets::tar_manifest(
      script = file.path(root, "docs", "_targets.R")
    )
    nrow(manifest)
  } else NA_integer_
}, error = function(e) NA_integer_)

cat("# > scripts/fetch_*.{R,py}  (not run at render time — too expensive)\n")
cat(n_r, " R fetchers + ", n_py, " Python fetchers = ", length(fetch_scripts),
    " total\n", sep = "")
cat("\n")
cat("# > src/pipeline.t  (T-language pipeline)\n")
cat(if (is.na(pipeline_lines)) "(not found)"
    else paste0(pipeline_lines, " lines"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("\n")
cat("# > targets::tar_manifest()  (R targets pipeline driving docs/)\n")
cat(if (is.na(n_targets)) "(could not parse)"
    else paste0(n_targets, " targets"), "\n", sep = "")
```
